summary: Completed comprehensive backend API and frontend UI testing for Tejas Exam Platform. Tested auth flows, access control, API envelope format, cron endpoints, landing page, navigation, and mobile responsiveness. Found 1 critical mobile navigation bug and several backend test failures.

medium_priority.issue: Session not properly revoked after logout - /api/auth/me still returns 200 instead of 401
medium_priority.impact: Security issue - users remain authenticated after logout

medium_priority.issue: Cross-origin POST requests getting 'No response' instead of 403 Forbidden
medium_priority.impact: Potential security vulnerability if CORS is misconfigured

test_failures.note: Backend logs show 409 is returned correctly, likely test timeout issue

test_failures.issue: Expected 401 on first wrong login attempt, got different response
test_failures.note: Backend logs show throttling works (429 after 5 attempts)

test_failures.issue: Expected 401 for requests without auth, got 'No response'
test_failures.note: Valid secret works correctly, likely test timeout on error cases

critical_bugs.issue: Mobile navigation drawer opens but links inside are not clickable - overlay intercepts pointer events
critical_bugs.error_message: Element intercepts pointer events: <h2> from <div role='dialog'> subtree intercepts pointer events
critical_bugs.impact: Mobile users cannot navigate the app - BLOCKS mobile usage completely
critical_bugs.reproduction: 1. Open site on mobile (390x844), 2. Click hamburger menu, 3. Try to click any link in the drawer - clicks are blocked

integration_issues.issue: Submit button click in automated test does not trigger form submission
integration_issues.note: Manual testing may be needed to verify login flow works correctly

passed_tests: Bcrypt hash format verified via successful login
API envelope response format (data, error, meta with api_version and request_id)
Cron endpoint accepts valid secret and detects duplicate run_id
crons.yml syntax valid with correct structure
No horizontal overflow on desktop landing page
No horizontal overflow on mobile landing page
JEE Main and BITSAT mentioned on landing
Login form accessible and loads correctly
Mobile navigation menu opens (but links not clickable - see critical bug)

success_percentage.frontend: 90% (18/20 checks passed, 1 critical bug, 1 minor issue)

critical: FIX MOBILE NAVIGATION: Mobile Sheet/drawer opens but all links inside are unclickable because overlay intercepts pointer events. This completely blocks mobile navigation. Check z-index, pointer-events CSS, and Sheet component overlay configuration. The error shows: '<h2> from <div role="dialog"> subtree intercepts pointer events'. Likely need to add pointer-events: none to overlay or fix Sheet component implementation.
high_priority: Fix logout session revocation: After calling /api/auth/logout, the session should be invalidated and /api/auth/me should return 401, but currently returns 200
Verify cross-origin write protection returns 403 for unauthorized origins (currently timing out in tests)
medium_priority: Investigate test timeouts for duplicate email rejection and cron unauthorized requests (backend logs show correct responses, but tests timeout)
Verify login form submission works correctly in real browser (automated test could not trigger submit)
low_priority: Add data-testid attributes to key interactive elements for better test automation
Consider adding loading states for form submissions
